component.name: Minuett
component.summary: Library-first music player with playlist sync and a parametric equalizer

description.p: Minuett is a music player in the spirit of RealPlayer 10: a glossy transport strip, a library you can browse by playlist, artist, album, genre or year, and a Now Playing queue.

ul.li: Import YouTube playlists and keep each one up to date individually; only newly added songs are downloaded
Downloads are saved as Opus, or MP3 V0 if you prefer
Gapless playback for Opus, FLAC, AAC/M4A, MP3, Ogg Vorbis and WAV
Tag editor with batch editing and cover art
10-band parametric equalizer with a live response curve and presets
Themes written in CSS, including looks based on popular editor themes
No telemetry and no accounts of its own; it goes online only when asked

description.p: Downloading from YouTube is only permitted in the cases its terms allow. Use the downloader for content you have the right to keep.

screenshot.caption: The 10-band parametric equalizer with its live response curve

description.p: Resizable columns in the Playlists list, and more reliable YouTube sign-in detection.
First release: playback, library, tag editing, playlist sync, equalizer and themes.
